summary: Rezolve AI plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release commenting on Commerce.com's Q2 2026 results, following Commerce.com's rejection of Rezolve's earlier acquisition proposal. The release contrasts Commerce.com's flat revenue, declining subscriptions, and reduced guidance with Rezolve's expected H1 revenue growth and reaffirmed $360 million outlook. No transaction terms or changes to Rezolve's own operations are stated. This is commentary on another company's results, not an active special situation involving the registrant.
